## Problem

What problem does this change address?

## Change

What changed, which owner areas are affected, and what remains out of scope?

## How it was verified

List exact commands and real results. Do not claim remote CI, deployment, AMD execution, or benchmarks that were not observed.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] Uses synthetic/non-sensitive test data.
- [ ] Does not log bodies, documents, prompts, credentials, or secret headers.
- [ ] Does not allow a model to set approval state.
- [ ] Contract artifacts were regenerated when API schemas changed.
